The proposed FINISH content mixes an instruction to place a morning lab order and a potential potassium replacement dosing contingent on lab result; since the lab result is not yet available, we cannot finalize a replacement order.

The agent found no results but did not attempt to retrieve potassium data with alternative search parameters (e.g., broader date ranges, different query methods) before concluding the search was exhaustive. More critically, the FINISH action does not actually place any orders—it only provides recommendations and templates. The task requires the agent to complete the orders, not defer them to the clinician.
